title: Cambodia’s Growing Market
text: Cambodia is one of the most dynamic and promising markets in ASEAN. Although economic growth has moderated somewhat compared to previous years, the country continues to develop steadily, supported by resilient domestic demand, infrastructure investment, and the recovery of tourism and exports. As incomes rise and the affluent and upper-middle-income populations expand, consumer interest in high-quality imported foods is growing significantly, particularly in major cities such as Phnom Penh, Siem Reap, and Sihanoukville. While imported products from China, South Korea, and other countries are widely available, Japanese food is increasingly valued by both consumers and business clients for its reputation for safety and high quality. LOKA brings authentic Japanese flavors to the Cambodian market through reliable sourcing, stable distribution, consistent quality, and professional service.

title: An Extensive Product Range
text: As a specialized wholesaler of Japanese products, LOKA Japanese Foods & Beverage offers one of Cambodia’s largest selections of Japanese food and beverages. Our portfolio includes more than 800 products, ranging from fresh seafood for sushi and raw consumption to Japanese Wagyu beef, agricultural products, beverages, and seasonings. We also supply alcoholic beverages such as Japanese sake, frozen foods, and other temperature-controlled products, ensuring access to fresh, authentic Japanese food. We regularly source new products in response to market trends and customer requests, continually expanding our selection to meet our customers’ needs.

title: Serving a Wide Range of Industries
text: With a track record of serving more than 600 businesses, LOKA has established strong partnerships with key players across the food and beverage industry. Our customers include major supermarkets, restaurants, international hotel brands, retailers, e-commerce platforms, and other wholesalers. Through these partnerships, Japanese food products distributed by LOKA are now widely available throughout Cambodia.

title: Fast and Nationwide Delivery
text: We supply high-quality products to businesses and consumers throughout Cambodia, with a focus on major cities such as Phnom Penh, Siem Reap, and Sihanoukville. Our efficient, proprietary logistics system enables us to deliver a wide range of wholesale products quickly and reliably, even for small orders. While minimum order quantities apply to certain products, many items are available in small quantities, including single packs. Please contact us to discuss urgent orders and your specific requirements. For large-volume orders, including made-to-order purchases, we may also be able to offer more competitive pricing.

title: Strong Global Partnerships
text: With partner companies in Bangkok, Thailand, and Osaka, Japan, LOKA has established its own import network. Through close communication with our Japanese partners, we stay up to date with the latest trends in Japan and carefully select products suited to the Cambodian market. Our partners manage the process from sourcing through export, ensuring a transparent and reliable supply chain.

title: A Global Logistics Network
text: Our logistics network is built around three key strengths: temperature-controlled transportation across all product categories, flexible land, sea, and air freight, and frequent shipments. In addition to importing food from Japan, we regularly source products from neighboring countries, including Thailand, Vietnam, and Malaysia, allowing us to offer a diverse product range. From Japan, we air-freight fresh seafood approximately twice a week and import dedicated refrigerated or frozen containers every month, without sharing container space with other importers. From neighboring countries, we arrange weekly truck deliveries, regular monthly container shipments, and approximately five refrigerated container shipments per year. Supported by frequent and reliable container logistics, we provide a consistent supply of products to meet our customers’ needs.

title: Support You Can Rely On
text: With approximately 100 employees, including Japanese staff based in Cambodia, we provide accessible, responsive support to our customers. We aim to create an environment where customers can consult with LOKA whenever they need assistance. We can also share our delivery schedules and work with customers to develop long-term ordering plans, helping them manage their procurement more effectively.

title: Benefits of Our Group Network
text: LOKA Japanese Foods & Beverage is operated by S.E.A.T.S Inc., a Japanese trading company. Our group also includes S.E.A.T.S Farm, which focuses on agricultural production and development; NOVA MARKETING, which specializes in digital marketing; and PISA FOOD RETAIL, our retail business. By combining our capabilities, we can offer tailored solutions to meet a variety of customer needs. For example, we can supply Kampot fresh pepper and vegetables grown by S.E.A.T.S Farm, while NOVA MARKETING can support promotional content and marketing activities. These synergies allow us to provide value beyond food supply alone.

title: Extensive Experience and Market Insights
text: We actively participate in trade shows and business-matching events, keeping a close eye on market trends and new products in Japan, Cambodia, and around the world. Our expertise comes from multiple areas of the business: LOKA’s B2B import and wholesale operations serving local restaurants and retailers; NOVA’s e-commerce platform, which has served a cumulative total of more than 10,000 consumers across Cambodia; and our directly operated specialty retail stores, where we engage with customers face to face through activities such as product tastings. Drawing on these diverse experiences and insights, we help customers grow their businesses with practical support and solutions from multiple perspectives.
